description: This file defines the AWS SDK client class for interacting with Amazon Interactive Video Service (IVS). It declares class methods for various API operations related to IVS, providing both synchronous and asynchronous methods. The class extends a generic AWS client, indicating it is part of the AWS SDK infrastructure.

classes.name: IVSClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the Amazon Interactive Video Service (IVS), providing methods to perform various operations such as creating, deleting, and listing channels, stream keys, and sessions.

methods.name: batchGetChannel
methods.description: Retrieves information about multiple channels in a single request.

methods.name: batchGetChannelAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves information about multiple channels.

methods.name: batchGetStreamKey
methods.description: Retrieves information about multiple stream keys.

methods.name: batchGetStreamKeyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves information about multiple stream keys.

methods.name: batchStartViewerSessionRevocation
methods.description: Starts revocation of viewer sessions in batch.

methods.name: batchStartViewerSessionRevocationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously starts revocation of viewer sessions.

methods.name: createChannelAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new IVS channel.

methods.name: createPlaybackRestrictionPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a playback restriction policy.

methods.name: deletePlaybackKeyPairAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a playback key pair.

methods.name: deletePlaybackRestrictionPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a playback restriction policy.

methods.name: getChannel
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific channel.

methods.name: getChannelAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves information about a specific channel.

methods.name: getPlaybackKeyPair
methods.description: Retrieves details of a playback key pair.

methods.name: getPlaybackKeyPairAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a playback key pair.

methods.name: getPlaybackRestrictionPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a playback restriction policy.

methods.name: getRecordingConfiguration
methods.description: Gets details of a recording configuration.

methods.name: getRecordingConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets details of a recording configuration.

methods.name: getStreamKey
methods.description: Retrieves details of a stream key.

methods.name: getStreamSession
methods.description: Gets details of a stream session.

methods.name: getStreamSessionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets details of a stream session.

methods.name: importPlaybackKeyPair
methods.description: Imports an existing playback key pair.

methods.name: importPlaybackKeyPairAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously imports a playback key pair.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: startViewerSessionRevocationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously starts revocation of viewer sessions.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: updatePlaybackRestrictionPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a playback restriction policy.
